memories_after: [Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, reports/ files such as reports/weekly.txt are created in the ticket worktree and committed to branch agenium/<TICKET> before submit_report merges to main.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) Work in the docs project is done in the git worktree at projects/docs/.agenium/worktrees/<TICKET> on branch agenium/<TICKET>.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) Before submitting a report for a file with byte-level requirements in the docs project, verify by reading raw bytes (e.g. [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes) that no BOM precedes the first line.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"os":"windows","software":"powershell"}) Command execution in this environment runs via Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe). PowerShell 5.1's Set-Content -Encoding utf8 writes a UTF-8 BOM; to write BOM-free files use -Encoding utf8NoBOM in PowerShell 7 or [IO.File]::WriteAllText with a UTF8Encoding($false).

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"os":"windows","project":"docs"}) The docs project enforces conventions with a pre-merge check that validates file contents and blocks the merge if a required line such as the owner line is missing; the check requires the very first bytes to match the owner line exactly, so files must be written as UTF-8 without BOM (a BOM makes the first line fail).

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) When creating a file under deliverables/ or reports/ in the docs project, make its first line 'Owner: docs-team', otherwise the pre-merge check fails and the ticket is reopened.

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, every team document created in deliverables/ or reports/ must name its owning team on its first line; for this repo the first line is exactly 'Owner: docs-team'.
